_about: Embraer 190-E2, from APM 5824 Rev 25 (Nov 29/24; Section 02 Aug 05/22) Figure 2.1 General Aircraft Dimensions (page index 19): side, plan and front views on one sheet, black lines over a pale yellow fill (layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill, as Airbus's). Drawn to one scale both ways (the plan's 10.0 m tailplane and the front's 33.72 m span agree with the side's length to 0.3%). Scaled by the figure's 36.33 m nose-to-tail-cone length (Section 2.2.1 prints 36.24 m overall). Pixels of layers.py rasters at scale 16, line centres. Windows joined to other lines (two to the 6.82 m and 24.57 m dimensions' extension lines, four to the wing's) are placed at their drawn centres (windowsAlso); windowMinWidth leaves out a dashed window on the far side.

sources.title: Embraer, E-Jets E2 Airport Planning Manual (APM 5824 Rev 25, Nov 29/24), Section 02, Figure 2.1 General Aircraft Dimensions (E190-E2); Figure 2.19 cabin cross-section
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/e290/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. Scaled by the figure's 36.33 m nose-to-tail-cone length; the manual's text prints 36.24 m overall, 0.25% shorter.
